FlexScriptClass.name: Particles.System
FlexScriptClass.Summary: The singleton manager for the Particles module. Discovers every Particles.Emitter in the model and batch-draws all of their particles in one pass at draw time.

Description.p: Exactly one system exists per model (auto-created when the first emitter is dropped). Access it via the static Particles.system accessor:
Holds global render/visibility controls and read-only performance stats. The emitters own their handles and per-emitter spec; the system only draws particles.

Property.name: liveCap
Property.Summary: Hard cap on the number of live particles evaluated per emitter (graceful degradation for heavy scenes).

Property.name: showPlanes
Property.Summary: 1 = draw every emitter's region outline (the wireframe shape); 0 = hide.

Property.name: showArrows
Property.Summary: 1 = draw every emitter's aim pyramid; 0 = hide.

Property.name: arrowSize
Property.Summary: World-unit size of the aim pyramid handle (constant size, independent of emitter scale).

Property.name: lod
Property.Summary: 1 = distance LOD on. Far emitters emit fewer particles (the emission rate is scaled by (lodStart/distance)^2 beyond lodStart), cutting draw cost.

Property.name: lodStart
Property.Summary: Distance (length units) within which an emitter keeps full detail; beyond it, the LOD rate falloff begins.

Property.name: lodMin
Property.Summary: Floor on the LOD multiplier (0-1): how sparse a far emitter is allowed to get. 1 = never thin.

Property.name: statEmitterCount
Property.Summary: Read-only: number of emitters found this frame.

Property.name: statTotalLive
Property.Summary: Read-only: total live particles drawn this frame across all emitters.

Property.name: statBuildMs
Property.Summary: Read-only: milliseconds spent evaluating particles this frame.

Property.name: statDrawMs
Property.Summary: Read-only: milliseconds spent drawing particles this frame.
